title: 검찰 및 특별사법경찰관리 등의 개인정보 처리에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 검찰 및 특별사법경찰관리 등의 개인정보 처리에 관한 규정
full_text: Article 4 (Processing of Sensitive Information, etc. by Persons Other Than Prosecution Officials) Where unavoidable for performing duties referred to in the subparagraphs of Article 2, persons other than prosecution officials who perform such duties pursuant to statutes, including expert investigative advisers under the Criminal Procedure Act and members of committees deliberating on the suspension of execution of sentences, may process materials containing sensitive information under Article 23 of the Act, personally identifiable information under Article 24 of the Act, resident registration numbers under Article 24-2 of the Act, or other personal information.
